meta.role: census (coverage only; adjudicates nothing; no frame, label or grade read)
meta.fetch_rule: season in fetch_seasons and at least one third of the probe's sampled games full
meta.downstream_rule: a (level, season) cell of class result_only, and any game with games_full false, contributes no pitch-event value; batted-ball hitData is present in result-only games too
